MOD = 1000000007

p, k = map(int, input().split())
if k > 1:
    order = 1
    cur = 1
    for i in range(1, p):
        cur = (cur * k) % p
        if cur == 1:
            order = i
            break
    exponent = (p - 1) // order
    result = 1
    for _ in range(exponent):
        result = (result * p) % MOD
    print(result)
elif k == 1:
    result = 1
    for _ in range(p):
        result = (result * p) % MOD
    print(result)
elif k == 0:
    result = 1
    for _ in range(p - 1):
        result = (result * p) % MOD
    print(result)
</translated_code>
